podcast.title: Difficult Transition
podcast.body: The shift from Britpop to Post-Britpop proved to be a significant challenge for many bands, with artists like Oasis and Suede struggling to successfully adapt their established sounds to the evolving musical landscape of the late 1990s. "es difícil el salto del Britpop al POSPRIPOP, que se la tragan todo bastante o así."
